items.title: Arturo O'Farrill interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 6, 2024
items.q: I know Victor, sure. Bronx Conexion.

ctx.x: And it’s just stunning. I’ve learned some — we’ve had some guests here over the years, Victor Rendon and others —
I know Victor, sure. Bronx Conexion.

I’m just starting to realize the depth of this. And again, I was going to bring this up later but I watched your — I think it was a quintet or a sextet on the Tiny Desk Concert and the night before I watched it I was doing a little jazz gig and okay it’s time for drum breaks and what do we do, we go all right, we’re going to play on the downbeat every two measures and the drummer’s going to fill it in. That’s sort of typical. So on this piece you did called “In Whom” when it was time for the drum feature — I’m…
